content.short: Increment Finance provides a DeFi hub on Flow.
content.description: Increment Finance delivers a full suite of DeFi capabilities on the Flow blockchain, pairing Swap, a DEX-aggregator, Lending, and Liquid Staking into a single, unified interface. Users can trade assets, obtain leverage through lending, stake tokens, and generate yields without leaving the platform. The project aims to be an interest-earning, capital-efficient DeFi liquidity engine that serves Flow users and strengthens the broader Flow ecosystem.
